title: SAF-T-style source-record intake and recompute engine
scope: BP1: accept a SAF-T-style export (general ledger journals, supplier and customer ledgers, payments) for large groups, standardise it, flag data problems without fixing them, recompute VAT and key income-tax lines and produce a line-by-line declared-versus-recomputed difference report with a record quality score

acceptance.text: A documented SAF-T-style intake schema (subset sufficient for VAT and key CIT lines) with the original file preserved via TAX-032 hashing; standardisation to Maloti, ISO dates and standard account categories; arithmetic, duplicate and TIN checks flag issues and never silently correct them

Deterministic recompute of output VAT, input VAT and selected income-tax lines from the source records; the difference report lists declared, recomputed and difference per line with source record IDs; each record gets complete/verified/unverified/contradicted quality and low quality alone never produces an action

Synthetic SAF-T fixtures for at least two groups, one clean and one with planted 'cooked' figures that the recompute detects; tests cover balanced/unbalanced journals, duplicates, decimal exactness and the expected differences; wording says RSL independently validates and the taxpayer remains responsible
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Synthetic SAF-T fixtures for at least two groups, one clean and one with planted 'cooked' figures that the recompute detects; tests cover balanced/unbalanced journals, duplicates, decimal exactness and the expected differences; wording says RSL independently validates and the taxpayer remains responsible

evidence.text: ai/tools/source_recompute.py: documented SAF-T-style subset (header, sales_summary, supplier_invoices, journals); DD/MM/YYYY standardised and counted; balanced journals, duplicates, supplier reference format, VAT arithmetic and sub-ledger/GL tie flagged, never corrected. Original-file hashing stays with TAX-032 evidence storage (not re-implemented here).

Deterministic recompute of output/input VAT and refund per period; line-by-line comparison with return IDs; persistent-excess logic separates timing from real excess; record quality complete/verified/unverified/contradicted; match_lines_to_books finds each claimed invoice in the books. Low quality alone produces no action.

data/synthetic/tax113_saft_groups.json: clean group (late-claimed invoice, DD/MM date) and cooked group (M24,000 over-declared, duplicate, unbalanced journal); RecomputeTests cover both, decimal exactness, float refusal and the responsibility wording.

PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/277. python3 scripts/dev.py check: Workspace checks passed; python3 scripts/quality.py: First-party quality checks passed (ruff, mypy, frontend build); validate.py passed.
